record.source_text: If a more favourable provision on the charging of proportional daily allowances is contained in collective agreements or works agreements concluded on the basis of special collective agreement authorisations, or is based on service (salary) regulations of corporations under public law approved by the supervisory authority, it shall be taken into account. c) If, in the case of a domestic business trip, no higher costs for overnight accommodation are proven, an amount of up to 200 S may be taken into account as an overnight allowance including the cost of breakfast. d) Daily allowances for foreign business trips may be taken into account at the maximum rate of the foreign travel rates for federal employees. e) If, in the case of a foreign business trip, no higher costs for overnight accommodation— 152.
